steps: 1. In Mod Tweaker, bind **Enter HUD Edit Mode** and start an Adventure mission.
2. Press the key once and confirm normal character and camera input stops while the mouse controls the editor.
3. Drag the visible Equipment display and Career Ability display a short distance, then exit and re-enter edit mode.
4. Repeat on a career with a visible Overcharge or Energy bar if available.
5. Run `/gut_regression_test`, exit normally, and attach the newest console log plus screenshots of any element whose edit box is missing or misaligned.
assertions: Each deliberate entry produces one bounded coverage snapshot, never per-frame spam. Visible registered elements report enough scenegraph and bounds evidence to distinguish ready, fallback, and missing geometry; Equipment and Career Ability displays move without jumping away from the cursor. The log identifies the remaining resize-handle and hidden-element work without altering gameplay outside edit mode.
Enter edit mode via keybind callback; one [gut:310] coverage snapshot; simulate drag per registered element, assert offset saved and reloaded; resize has nothing to test.
